description: This PHP script is designed to perform API tests for the TestLink project, specifically testing the creation of test suites via XMLRPC calls. It sets up test parameters, initializes a client, and executes test cases related to creating test suites with different identifiers and configurations.

classes.name: IXR_Client
classes.description: A class used to make XMLRPC calls to the TestLink API server.

methods.name: runTest
methods.description: Function that executes a test by sending a request via the IXR_Client.
